## Task completion is not adoption

The six task records identify MT-01–MT-06 and mark them done. Their completion criteria concern an inventory, an independent audit, theoretical proposals, notation and reconciliation. MT-03–06 record expressly bounded evidence; MT-03’s notation entry says “accepted within scope,” while its resolution excludes blanket adoption. MT-06 similarly says completion is not blanket adoption, normative release or operational validation. These records support completion of the packages, not adoption of the remaining candidate definitions.

The current theoretical-development state and reconciliation are consistent with that distinction: proposed structural/process theory exists; the initial notation is accepted; the reconciliation says it has not made candidate definitions accepted rules. No differing task-completion claim is used as acceptance evidence here.
